name: Guangzhou Hengyun Enterprises Holding Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Hengyun Enterprises Holding Ltd produces and sells electricity and heat in China. It operates in four segments: Power, Steam, Energy Storage, and Environmental Protection and Others. The company engages in the financial industry; battery manufacturing; solar energy generation; wholesale and retail of refined oil, hydrogen energy, and natural gas, as well as photovoltaic power generation, charging business, energy storage business, and sale of related products. It also provides technical services. Guangzhou Hengyun Enterprises Holding Ltd was founded in 1993 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
